notes: Retired legacy modem debug/timeout controls have no provider in this kernel; no claim of replacement or feature parity.
Current rmnet_core always owns QMAP deaggregation; mode 3 selects all protocol optimizations without changing the core.
Mode 2 is an independent UDP-only administrative mask; setting the quickack knob cannot override it.
SLA still requires explicit experimental packaging; this fix does not hide a missing module.
